## Goal
A calm page for the moments that worry people but are not errors. `docs/user/troubleshooting.md` covers error messages: link to it, don't repeat it.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Up to 11 situations, each headed in the reader's words ("When the screen says ..."), with: the exact words the app shows (cited), what it means, one thing to do, and when to stop and ask someone you trust.
- Include at least: "Nothing needs you today" (`src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py:267`); "Free My ID is checking now" (`dashboard.py:262`); emails "waiting for your OK", "Look at them" and "Approve and send" (`dashboard.py:253`, `:255`, `:473`); "Not running yet for ..." with "Fix it" (`dashboard.py:242-244`); a site that wants a photo ID, an account or your phone number (`dashboard.py:129`); a listing that came back (`dashboard.py:277`, `src/freemyid/wizard/views.py:41`); the computer was off for days ("catches up", `dashboard.py:503`); a phone-call step and its optional note (`dashboard.py:189`); wanting to pause ("Go back to practice mode" `dashboard.py:519`, "Turn off" `dashboard.py:507`); someone calling or emailing as "Free My ID" and asking for money or a Social Security number (the app never asks, `ui.py:266-267`).
- No situation promises an outcome from a site ("requested", not "removed").
- Expected: `tests/copilot/test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py` fails exactly one case, `test_user_page_is_reachable[what-to-do-when.md]`, because nothing links the new page yet. That is by design: WO-330 links it, and in-house merges this WO and WO-330 together before pushing. Record that one failure in VENDOR_STATUS.md; any other failure is yours to fix.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Page rules (new help pages, WO-311..320):
- Quote screen text and button labels exactly as the app shows them, with the source as `src/freemyid/<path>.py:NNN` in an HTML comment on the same line. `tests/copilot/test_cp_source_citations.py` checks that the line exists and that quoted text on that line is in that file. Cite anything that isn't under `src/freemyid/` in words ("brokers/checklists.yaml, line 22"; "packaging/windows/splash_win.py, line 20"), because only `src/freemyid/` files resolve.
- Link only to pages that exist on main today. Don't link to other new pages in this batch: WO-330 adds the help-topics page that links them all.
- First line under the title: who the page is for and what it helps with, in one sentence. Then short sentences (about 15 words), one step per line, numbered steps. No screenshots (none can be made offline). No web addresses except ones the app itself shows; never a GitHub link for regular users.
